text:
maya: FYI — after flipping the new price-sheet (AB variant 'alpha-v3') to 20% cohort today we see a spike of small duplicate invoice lines for ~12 EU accounts. Not the same pattern as yesterday's canary. low-value but noisy.
jess: is this the grandfathering mapping kicking in? could be both old and new price rules applied for overlap windows.
ben: can you paste the rule set you deployed? we changed the grandfathering TTL to 1h last week.
maya: deployed ruleset id `price_sheet_alpha_v3:rev7`. grandfather_ttl = 3600s. docs: https://internal.redwood/pricing/rules/alpha-v3
liam: quick diagnostic query to show duplicated billing keys:
```sql
SELECT account_id, billing_key, COUNT(*) AS cnt, MIN(created_at) AS first, MAX(created_at) AS last
FROM invoice_lines
WHERE price_sheet = 'alpha-v3' AND region='eu-west' AND created_at >= '2026-03-21'
GROUP BY account_id, billing_key
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 100;
```
sara: ran that at 09:12; returns 24 rows, mostly cnt=2, a couple cnt=3. timestamps show duplicates within ~30s of each other.
jess: that smells like a race between legacy grandfathering job and real-time apply path. maybe both wrote invoice lines before the TTL prevented duplicates.
ben: Ops — can you hold writes to invoice_lines for the cohort while we triage? we don't want more noise until we understand.
liam: set a temporary write-lock on billing writer for price_sheet alpha-v3 in eu-west at 09:20 UTC. lock token `lock-2032223333`. will keep for 30m.
ops-bot: billing write-lock applied by liam: lock-2032223333. TTL 30m.
maya: finance — we need emergency approval to auto-merge duplicate lines under the same billing_key for amounts < $50 without manual review. This would create credits for duplicates automatically. Approve?
ben: I approve auto-merge/credit for amount < $50 for bulk cleanup (max exposure $1k total) now. Anything above escalate to finance lead.
sara: I'll prepare the cleanup batch. sample reconciliation logic: 1) group by billing_key, 2) keep earliest line, 3) sum amounts, 4) create credit for (total - kept.amount) if > $0.
maya: sample credit memo we can use in bulk: 
---
Customer: {account_id}
Reason: Duplicate invoice lines created during alpha-v3 price rollout due to overlapping grandfathering and realtime apply.
Action: Issued full credit of ${amount}
Reference: FIN-4701
---
ben: ensure support gets templated replies. don't contact customers proactively for <$20 credits.
jess: opening INF-3350 for pricing apply path race. notes: possible double-write from legacy job (id: gf-job-1) + realtime job (id: price-apply).
liam: quick patch idea: add a conditional upsert on invoice_lines keyed by billing_key+price_sheet with low-latency conflict handling. I'll prototype after lock removed.
ops-bot: INF-3350 created and assigned to eng-platform. link: https://b.internal/INF-3350
ben: timeline ask — can billing ops finish the bulk dedupe and credits within 2 hours? we need to minimize customer noise before EOD.
sara: bulk job queued. estimate 90 minutes. creating tickets FIN-4710..FIN-4721 per account.
maya: also: for future rollouts add a gating check to ensure grandfathering job is paused for X minutes during handover. add to rollout SOP.
jess: adding gating step: "pause gf-job-1 for 5m before alpha-v3 flips, verify no pending writes" to rollout playbook. PR: https://git.internal/pricing/rollout/123
ben: one more: let's capture net revenue delta per cohort after cleanup and decide whether to retroactively adjust experiment metrics. maya, own?
maya: yes. I'll run cohort net-revenue vs expected and post results. sample query I'll run: 
```sql
SELECT cohort, SUM(amount_usd) AS net_revenue
FROM invoice_lines
WHERE price_sheet IN ('alpha-v2','alpha-v3')
  AND created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-21' AND '2026-03-22'
GROUP BY cohort;
```
liam: unlocking billing writer now (lock-2032223333 removed).
ops-bot: lock removed by liam at 2026-03-21T09:58:10Z.
sara: bulk dedupe job started. running dry-run first.
ben: thanks team. please escalate >$50 account cases to finance-leads. keep thread updated.
maya: will post reconciliation and credit summary here when done. leaving the thread open.
ops-bot: archival reminder: thread auto-archives in 90 days.
